training_window.policy: All training races strictly precede the five-day test window. Same-day results are not used to predict another race on that date.

data_source.final_odds_policy: Official confirmed final odds are retrospective market benchmark only; they are not model input.

C_performance_pace.rank_gap_definition: market rank minus LAB rank; positive means LAB ranks the horse higher
C_performance_pace.comparison_policy: LAB and market ranks are recomputed on the same horses with valid official final odds in each race; outcomes are official finishing positions.

integrated_strategy_E.policy: Fixed 0.30 calibrated top-win probability gate; role-specific trifecta ranking blend 0.10; 2-3-4 formation. The reference uses the same qualifying races and formation with ordinary ranking, isolating the ranking change. Parameters are not selected on the holdout fold.

limitations: Five calendar days are a short sample; results are diagnostic and cannot establish stable hit rate or profitability.
The comparison uses official final odds as a retrospective market benchmark, not as a pre-off input.
D4 is research-only; no live model weights, saved predictions, or production tickets are changed.
